stem.text: The DNA of prokaryotes is naked and circular.
Which statement describes how the DNA of eukaryotes differs from that of prokaryotes?

A.text: It has a nuclear envelope around it and is a double helix.

B.text: It has a nuclear envelope around it and is circular.

C.text: It has proteins attached to it and is a double helix.

D.text: It has proteins attached to it and is linear.
